_note: configurable-types-domain-model task 3.5 (the Post half) — a body's formal post is a PositionType, and holding it is a PositionHold on the holder's membership. Post carried label/role and dates that described neither the position nor the holder well, and Membership.post was a bare reference with no duration and no hold type. Posts are copied onto position types and every membership's post onto a position hold by the counted MigratePostsToPositionHolds, which also repoints an appointment decision's targetPosts; an enacted appointment now writes a PositionHold instead of Membership.post.

Post.description: SUPERSEDED (configurable-types-domain-model): a post is a PositionType on its body. `label` became `name`, `role` became `key`, and the holder's dates live on the PositionHold of each membership that held it. Definition and slug are kept (hardDelete:false, existing rows).

post.title: Post (superseded)
post.description: SUPERSEDED: the position a membership holds is a PositionHold that points at this membership. Kept so existing rows stay readable; nothing writes it any more.

targetPosts.description: Revealed when decisionType=appointment. Zero or more positions (PositionType) of the target body the appointment fills. When the decision is enacted, each candidate's membership gets a PositionHold on its paired position. Optional.

migratedFromObject.title: Migrated from
migratedFromObject.description: The identifier of the membership whose superseded post this hold was copied from. Set only by the post migration; absent on seeds, on holds an appointment wrote and on anything a person created.
